Installation

You can install the development version from GitHub:

  • Using remotes:
## install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("{{github_account}}/templateRpackage")
  • Or using pak:
## install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("{{github_account}}/templateRpackage")
